summary.business_type: Free educational PWA for Italian primary school (classi 2ª-5ª): 8 quiz subjects + 1 canvas arcade game
resolved_today: RESOLVED 2026-08-25: Cloudflare was blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and OAI-SearchBot at the edge (403) despite robots.txt/llms.txt declaring open access. Fixed via dashboard: disabled legacy 'Block AI bots' toggle, set mixed-purpose-crawler preference to 'continue to be allowed', left new granular AI bot policies (Search/Agent/Training) disabled. Re-verified live with real user-agents: all 4 bots now return HTTP 200 with real page content.

RESOLVED 2026-08-25: Mobile CLS regression on /chi-siamo (0.254 Poor) and home (0.105 borderline). Root cause: shared footer's #questionsTotalCount starts with the HTML `hidden` attribute (zero layout footprint) and is populated by deferred JS after initial paint, wrapping to more rows at mobile width. Fixed by reserving layout space in CSS for the hidden state (min-width matching the populated text). Verified: reserved box matches populated box exactly on /chi-siamo mobile (0px shift, was 0.254).

RESOLVED 2026-08-25: Pre-existing bug found while testing the CLS fix on a real iPhone — the info-page footer's reserved bottom padding (132px) didn't cover its real wrapped height (169px) on /chi-siamo, clipping the 'Torna alla home' button text. Increased to 190px.

RESOLVED 2026-08-25: FAQPage schema text didn't match visible page text on matematica/geografia/storia/italiano (3 answers each, schema paraphrased/expanded beyond the visible HTML). Aligned schema to visible text 1:1 on all 4 pages. problemi.html's 4 extra worked-example <details> (incorrectly sharing the FAQ CSS class, making the page visually present 11 FAQ-style items vs 7 in schema) renamed to a distinct class — no visual change, resolves the count-gap confusion.

RESOLVED 2026-08-25: Added the site's first content image — a gameplay preview on /breakout, reusing/recapturing the existing og-breakout-1200x630.jpg asset (updated twice after user testing on a real device: first because it still showed the pre-restyle flat bricks instead of the current 'candy' style, then reframed to show the full game area including ball and paddle instead of cutting into empty space).
top_findings: /breakout page-type mismatch: Google rewards multi-game portal pages for the target query, not single-game landing pages — discussed with the site owner, accepted as-is (see Search Experience decision below)

findings.title: RESOLVED — Cloudflare edge-blocked major AI crawlers despite robots.txt/llms.txt declaring open access
findings.description: Found today via live user-agent testing: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot all received HTTP 403 'Your request was blocked' from Cloudflare's edge — before robots.txt was even consulted. Root cause: legacy 'Block AI bots' toggle set to 'Block on all pages'. Fixed same day: toggle disabled, mixed-purpose-crawler preference set to allow, new granular AI bot policies left disabled (matches the site's open-access intent). Re-verified live: all 4 bots now return 200 with real content.
findings.recommendation: None — resolved and verified. No further action.
